job_description: Senior Animator: Character Animation & Visual Development Department:  Animation / Creative Reports to:  Animation Director / Creative Director About Us We are an animation studio developing original animated stories, characters and worlds with a distinctive cinematic visual language. Our ambition is not to simply produce conventional 2D or 3D animation — we're building a studio with a strong, recognizable artistic identity, combining the emotional storytelling and hand-crafted feeling of traditional animation with the cinematic depth, atmosphere and technical sophistication of modern animation. We're also exploring AI-native animation and interactive worlds, where characters, environments and stories can eventually exist beyond a single film or episode. We're looking for a Senior Animator who can help us define and raise the quality bar of the studio. The Creative Direction Our visual ambition sits at the intersection of cinematic storytelling, expressive animation, rich world-building and emotional depth. We may look to works such as Arcane and Studio Ghibli as references; not to replicate their visual language, but to understand the qualities that make their worlds so compelling: distinctive character design, atmospheric environments, cinematic composition, emotional storytelling, and a strong sense of place. Our goal is to develop a visual identity that is entirely our own; contemporary, cinematic, human and unmistakably original. The world should feel beautifully crafted without becoming overly polished; imaginative without losing authenticity; technologically ambitious while retaining warmth and emotional character. The Creative Principles Cinematic  — Every frame should feel intentional, with strong composition, lighting, depth and visual storytelling. Human  — Characters should feel emotionally real and nuanced. Expression, gesture and small details should carry as much weight as spectacle. Atmospheric  — Light, colour, texture, weather, architecture and environment should create a world that feels lived-in and memorable. Distinctive  — We should avoid generic "AI animation" aesthetics or recognisable imitation of existing studios. Our visual language should be identifiable as ours. Culturally grounded  — Where the story draws from a particular place, culture or community, visual design should reflect that identity authentically rather than relying on generic globalised imagery. Imaginative, but believable  — The world can be fantastical and ambitious, but its materials, environments, characters and physical details should feel coherent and grounded. Ultimately, the ambition is not to create something that looks like Arcane or Studio Ghibli. The ambition is to create something that makes people say:  "I haven't seen anything quite like this before." References for Quality and Ambition Arcane / Fortiche — Cinematic composition, strong character acting, stylized 3D, hand-crafted 2D elements, excellent lighting and atmosphere, expressive faces, strong silhouettes, sophisticated camera language, dynamic action. Studio Ghibli — Natural and believable movement, emotional subtlety, human gestures, environmental storytelling, beautiful background integration, quiet moments, attention to small details, characters that feel alive rather than mechanically animated. Other useful references: Puss in Boots: The Last Wish, Klaus, Blue Eye Samurai, The Mitchells vs. the Machines, Love Death + Robots, Pixar character animation, Disney's strongest character-animation work, and high-end Japanese animated films. The objective is not imitation — our goal is to develop a new studio-specific visual language inspired by the strengths of these approaches. What We Are Looking For We are looking for an animator who understands that great animation is not simply about making a character move. It is about making the audience believe that the character  thinks → feels → decides → reacts → acts. You should have a strong understanding of: character acting, body mechanics, facial animation, gesture, timing and spacing, weight, anticipation, follow-through, secondary motion, posing, silhouette, camera awareness, emotional beats and cinematic storytelling. You should be able to animate both: High-energy sequences  — Action, running, fighting, jumping, falling, physical interaction, complex movement. Subtle sequences  — A character thinking, breathing, looking, hesitating, listening, reacting, hiding emotion or simply walking into a room.  The second category is particularly important to us. Responsibilities Character Animation Create high-quality character animation for films, series and short-form projects. Animate believable and emotionally engaging performances. Develop strong poses and silhouettes. Work closely with the Animation Director to establish performance standards. Refine facial expressions and body language. Maintain consistency across characters and sequences. Acting & Storytelling Interpret storyboards and scripts into meaningful performances. Understand the emotional intention of every shot. Make acting choices rather than simply following mechanical instructions. Use timing, posing and movement to communicate character personality. Cinematic Animation Work with camera composition and staging. Understand how animation interacts with cinematography, lighting and editing. Create animation that works as part of a complete cinematic sequence rather than as isolated shots. Visual Development Participate in developing our studio's animation language. Experiment with stylized movement, timing and visual effects. Help establish reusable animation principles and standards. Contribute ideas for improving the quality and efficiency of our production pipeline. Collaboration Work closely with the Animation Director, Creative Director, storyboard artists, character designers, 3D artists, 2D artists, layout artists, FX artists, lighting artists, editors and technical artists.

job_description: Responsibilities & Context Association of Voluntary Actions for Society (AVAS) is a national non-profit, rights-based development organization working since 1998 to improve the lives of vulnerable and marginalized communities across Bangladesh. AVAS implements programs in health, gender equality, child protection, climate resilience, livelihood development, education and humanitarian response through strong community engagement and partnerships with government and international development agencies. The organization is committed to accountability, safeguarding, inclusion and sustainable community development. Project Summary Project 1 - Climate Resilience, Livelihoods and Local Governance Project (CRS Signature Programme): AVAS is implementing this 48-month project in four unions (Nilganj, Dhulasar, Latachapoli and Dalbuganj) of Kalapara Upazila, Patuakhali District, with support from Christian Aid. The project addresses the compounding impacts of cyclones, tidal surges, salinity intrusion and erratic rainfall on climate-vulnerable coastal communities, especially women, smallholder farmers, fisherfolk and persons with disabilities. It works across three interlinked outcomes: (1) strengthening climate-resilient, diversified and equitable livelihoods through climate-adaptive agriculture, renewable energy livelihoods, women-led producer groups and market linkages; (2) building locally led early warning, preparedness and shock-responsive support systems to help communities anticipate, withstand and recover from climate-induced disasters; and (3) strengthening inclusive climate governance so that communities, particularly women, can influence Loss & Damage advocacy, climate finance and local governance platforms. Project 2 - Transforming Women's Economic Lives in Kalapara (WTE Programme): AVAS is implementing this 4-year project (August 2026 - July 2030) across Mohipur and Latachapoli unions of Kalapara Upazila, under Christian Aid's Women Transforming Economies (WTE) Asia Multi-Country Cooperation programme. The project responds to the precarious, informal and gender-unequal working conditions of an estimated 1,000 women and adolescent girls working in the fish Arat (commission agents' shop) economy of Mohipur and Alipur. It works across three outcomes aligned with the WTE Theory of Change: (1) diversified and dignified livelihoods with increased women's control over income and assets, delivered through Women's Economic Hubs, financial literacy and microgrants; (2) safe, fair and gender-responsive working conditions in the Arat economy, through Women Workers' Circles, employer-worker dialogues and a Decent Work Pledge; and (3) strengthened women's collective voice in local and national economic governance and policy processes. job_description: Responsibilities & Context Association of Voluntary Actions for Society (AVAS) is a national non-profit, rights-based development organization working since 1998 to improve the lives of vulnerable and marginalized communities across Bangladesh. AVAS implements programs in health, gender equality, child protection, climate resilience, livelihood development, education and humanitarian response through strong community engagement and partnerships with government and international development agencies. The organization is committed to accountability, safeguarding, inclusion and sustainable community development. Project Summary Project 1 - Climate Resilience, Livelihoods and Local Governance Project (CRS Signature Programme): AVAS is implementing this 48-month project in four unions (Nilganj, Dhulasar, Latachapoli and Dalbuganj) of Kalapara Upazila, Patuakhali District, with support from Christian Aid. The project addresses the compounding impacts of cyclones, tidal surges, salinity intrusion and erratic rainfall on climate-vulnerable coastal communities, especially women, smallholder farmers, fisherfolk and persons with disabilities. It works across three interlinked outcomes: (1) strengthening climate-resilient, diversified and equitable livelihoods through climate-adaptive agriculture, renewable energy livelihoods, women-led producer groups and market linkages; (2) building locally led early warning, preparedness and shock-responsive support systems to help communities anticipate, withstand and recover from climate-induced disasters; and (3) strengthening inclusive climate governance so that communities, particularly women, can influence Loss & Damage advocacy, climate finance and local governance platforms. Project 2 - Transforming Women's Economic Lives in Kalapara (WTE Programme): AVAS is implementing this 4-year project (August 2026 - July 2030) across Mohipur and Latachapoli unions of Kalapara Upazila, under Christian Aid's Women Transforming Economies (WTE) Asia Multi-Country Cooperation programme. The project responds to the precarious, informal and gender-unequal working conditions of an estimated 1,000 women and adolescent girls working in the fish Arat (commission agents' shop) economy of Mohipur and Alipur. It works across three outcomes aligned with the WTE Theory of Change: (1) diversified and dignified livelihoods with increased women's control over income and assets, delivered through Women's Economic Hubs, financial literacy and microgrants; (2) safe, fair and gender-responsive working conditions in the Arat economy, through Women Workers' Circles, employer-worker dialogues and a Decent Work Pledge; and (3) strengthened women's collective voice in local and national economic governance and policy processes. S/he will be responsible for ensuring integrated delivery across all three project outcomes, climate-resilient livelihoods, anticipatory action and shock-responsive systems, and inclusive climate governance, while managing the project team, budget, government and donor relationships and ensuring compliance with AVAS and Christian Aid's programme quality, safeguarding and accountability standards. Key Duties and Responsibilities 1. Project Leadership & Management Provide overall strategic and operational leadership for the project across all three outcomes. Develop and oversee implementation of annual work plans, procurement plans, and budgets in line with the approved proposal. Ensure integrated, quality delivery of climate-resilient livelihood, early warning/preparedness, and climate governance activities. Lead risk management, problem-solving and adaptive management throughout the project cycle. 2. Technical Oversight & Quality Assurance Provide technical guidance and quality oversight to the MEAL Officer, Accounts and Admin Officer, and field-level staff. Ensure activities such as women-led producer group formation, early warning system strengthening, and climate governance dialogues are implemented to a high standard. Champion the integration of gender equality, social inclusion, and safeguarding across all project components. 3. Government & Stakeholder Coordination Build and maintain strong working relationships with Union Parishads, Upazila administration, Disaster Management Committees and relevant government departments. Team Management & Capacity Building Recruit, supervise, mentor and appraise project staff, fostering a collaborative and high-performing team culture. করছে কিনা দেখে নিতে হবে। যদি কাজ না করে তবে তা দ্রুত ঠিক করার ব্যবস্থা করতে হবে। এ্যাম্বুলেন্সটির সকল চাকায় হাওয়া পরিপূর্নভাবে আছে কিনা দেখে নিতে হবে। যদি না থাকে তবে তা দ্রুত হাওয়া দেয়ার ব্যবস্থা করতে হবে। স্পিয়ার চাকাটি ঠিক আছে কিনা। চাকা ঠিক না থাকলে চাকাটি নিকটস্থ গ্যারেজ এ ঠিক করার জন্য প্রদান করতে হবে। এ্যাম্বুলেন্স সংশ্লিষ্ট কাগজপত্র (প্রযোজ্য ক্ষেত্রে), ড্রাইভিং লাইসেন্স সাথে রাখতে হবে। প্রতিদিন কাজ শেষে নিম্নে বর্নিত চেকলিস্ট ব্যবহার করে বর্নিত কার্যসমূহ পালন করতে হবে – সকল লজিস্টিক মেডিকেল এ্যাসিস্ট্যান্ট কে বুঝিয়ে দিতে হবে। এ্যাম্বুলেন্স টি সঠিক ভাবে ও পরিপূর্ণ রূপে পরিষ্কার করতে হবে। এ্যাম্বুলেন্স টি সতর্কতার সাথে গ্যা্রেজ এ রাখতে হবে এবং গ্যারাজে ব্যাটারি চার্জ করার ব্যবস্থা করতে হবে। চার্জ করার ক্ষেত্রে LED ব্যাটারী চার্জের প্রোটোকল পালন করতে হবে। এ্যাম্বুলেন্স মেনটেনেন্স: নিম্ন লিখিত চেকলিস্ট এর মাধ্যমে এ্যাম্বুলেন্স এর মেনটেনেন্স করতে হবে। প্রতি সপ্তাহে একবার করে ব্যাটারি খুলে পরিষ্কার করতে হবে। যাতে ব্যাটারির কানেকশনে কোনো ধরণের কার্বন জমা না হয়। প্রতি ১ মাস পর পর ব্যাটারির পানির পরিমান দেখতে হবে এবং প্রয়োজনে ব্যাটারিতে পানি প্রদান করতে হবে। প্রতি ১৫ দিন পর পর কন্ট্রোলার চেক করতে হবে এবং যদি কোনো ত্রুটি লক্ষ্য করা যায় তবে তা দ্রুত ঠিক করার ব্যবস্থা গ্রহণ করতে হবে। এ্যাম্বুলেন্স এর যেকোনো সমস্যা দ্রুত সমাধানের জন্য কযেকটি গ্যারেজের নাম ঠিকানা ও ফোন নম্বর সংগ্রহ করে রাখতে হবে। প্রতি সপ্তাহে পুরো এ্যাম্বুলেন্স ধৌত করতে হবে এ্যাম্বুলেন্স এর নিচের সরঞ্জাম যেমন মোটর, ডিফেনটিয়াল ইত্যাদি যাতে ধৌতকরণ থেকে বাদ না পরে সেই ব্যাপারে লক্ষ্য রাখতে হবে।    অন্যান্য করনীয়সমূহ: এম্বুলেন্স ড্রাইভার তার সকল কাজের জন্য মেডিকেল এ্যাসিস্ট্যান্ট এর নিকট দায়ী থাকবেন। এম্বুলেন্সে বহনকারী রুগী হাসপাতাল এ বুঝিয়ে দিয়ে হাসপাতাল ত্যাগ করতে হবে। রোগীর জন্য অক্সিজেন সিলিন্ডার পূর্ন থাকার ব্যাপারে নজর রাখতে হবে এবং প্রয়োজন হলে অবশ্যই মেডিকেল এ্যাসিস্ট্যান্ট কে জানাতে হবে। কোন রোগী হাসপাতালে বহন করলে ফেরার পথে কোন যাত্রী বহন করা সম্পূর্ন নিষেধ। মৃত ব্যাক্তি বহনের ক্ষেত্রে লাশের সাথে ডেথ সার্টিফিকেট থাকতে হবে। কাদাযুক্ত পথ ও ঝুঁকিপূর্ণ কালভার্ট/ ব্রীজ দিয়ে কোন ক্রমেই গাড়ী চালানো যাবে না। এ্যাম্বুলেন্স এ অবৈধ মালামাল বহন সম্পূর্ন নিষেধ। সংস্থার সাথে সংশ্লিষ্ট কোন ব্যক্তির সাথে আর্থিক লেনদেন করা যাবে না।

job_description: Responsibilities & Context Association of Voluntary Actions for Society (AVAS) is a national non-profit, rights-based development organization working since 1998 to improve the lives of vulnerable and marginalized communities across Bangladesh. AVAS implements programs in health, gender equality, child protection, climate resilience, livelihood development, education and humanitarian response through strong community engagement and partnerships with government and international development agencies. The organization is committed to accountability, safeguarding, inclusion and sustainable community development. Project Summary AVAS is implementing the ECO-RESOLVE project in Bhola district, one of Bangladesh's most climate-exposed coastal districts, in partnership with Plan International Bangladesh. The 10-month project (September 26 to June 2026) aims to reduce climate and disaster-induced risks for vulnerable communities by strengthening locally led, ecosystem-based adaptation (EbA) systems. The project works across three interlinked outcomes: (1) establishing community- and youth-led institutional platforms for EbA - including EbA Action Groups (EAGs), school-based MetClubs and youth DRR volunteers - at union and school level; (2) supporting households to adopt diversified, climate-resilient and biodiversity-positive livelihood practices such as organic sack gardening, integrated fish-fruit-vegetable-duck (2FVD) models, vermicomposting, biochar and bio-digesters, alongside entrepreneurship and market linkage support; and (3) strengthening local disaster risk governance - Union and Upazila Disaster Management Committees (UDMC/UzDMC) - to integrate EbA into Community Risk Assessments (CRA) and Risk Reduction Action Plans (RRAP), early warning systems and cyclone shelter rehabilitation. The project places strong emphasis on MEAL, community accountability, safeguarding and gender-responsive, youth-centred programming, anchored within Plan Bangladesh's Programme Quality and Innovation (PQI)/PMERL system. Location:  Field-based across intervention unions, Bhola Sadar Reports to:  Project Manager Contract Duration: Contract Duration:  Fixed-term (10 month), Monthly Salary:  BDT 40000/- Vacancy Type:  Full Time Age Range:  28-45 Years Application Deadline:  17 September 2026 Position Summary The Technical Officer - Climate-Resilient Livelihood will lead implementation of the project's household-level, ecosystem-based livelihood interventions. The role covers promotion of climate-resilient agricultural practices, circular and low-carbon technologies, entrepreneurship and market linkages, and community-led ecosystem restoration (afforestation), working closely with the Department of Agricultural Extension (DAE) and other relevant government departments. Key Duties and Responsibilities 1. EbA Livelihood Promotion • Facilitate household adoption of organic sack gardening, the integrated Fish-Fruit-Vegetable-Duck (2FVD) model, vermicomposting, bio-pesticide preparation, and short-duration/diversified crop varieties. • Coordinate training and input support for agricultural demonstration farmers in collaboration with DAE, including verification of cash grant utilization against agreed milestones. 2. Circular & Low-Carbon Technologies • Support installation and uptake of zero-energy cooling units, bio-digesters, and household-level biochar production units. • Provide technical follow-up to ensure proper use and maintenance of these technologies by beneficiary households. 3. Entrepreneurship & Market Linkage • Deliver business skills and market linkage training to potential entrepreneurs and organize match-making events connecting producers with market actors. • Support beneficiaries to access input, output and financial market opportunities for climate-resilient products. 4. Ecosystem Restoration • Lead community-led afforestation activities, including sapling distribution, fencing support, site selection and maintenance planning. 5. Training, Monitoring & Reporting • Coordinate closely with the Union Supervisor and Technical Officer (MEAL) to monitor uptake, quality, and results of livelihood interventions. • Contribute technical inputs, case studies and evidence on livelihood outcomes for donor reporting and knowledge products. Skills Climate-Resilient Agriculture, Livelihoods, Value Chain Development, Community Facilitation

job_description: Responsibilities & Context Association of Voluntary Actions for Society (AVAS) is a national non-profit, rights-based development organization working since 1998 to improve the lives of vulnerable and marginalized communities across Bangladesh. AVAS implements programs in health, gender equality, child protection, climate resilience, livelihood development, education and humanitarian response through strong community engagement and partnerships with government and international development agencies. The organization is committed to accountability, safeguarding, inclusion and sustainable community development. Project Summary AVAS is implementing the ECO-RESOLVE project in Bhola district, one of Bangladesh's most climate-exposed coastal districts, in partnership with Plan International Bangladesh. The 10-month project (September 26 to June 2026) aims to reduce climate and disaster-induced risks for vulnerable communities by strengthening locally led, ecosystem-based adaptation (EbA) systems. The project works across three interlinked outcomes: (1) establishing community- and youth-led institutional platforms for EbA - including EbA Action Groups (EAGs), school-based MetClubs and youth DRR volunteers - at union and school level; (2) supporting households to adopt diversified, climate-resilient and biodiversity-positive livelihood practices such as organic sack gardening, integrated fish-fruit-vegetable-duck (2FVD) models, vermicomposting, biochar and bio-digesters, alongside entrepreneurship and market linkage support; and (3) strengthening local disaster risk governance - Union and Upazila Disaster Management Committees (UDMC/UzDMC) - to integrate EbA into Community Risk Assessments (CRA) and Risk Reduction Action Plans (RRAP), early warning systems and cyclone shelter rehabilitation. The project places strong emphasis on MEAL, community accountability, safeguarding and gender-responsive, youth-centred programming, anchored within Plan Bangladesh's Programme Quality and Innovation (PQI)/PMERL system. Location:  Field-based across intervention unions, Bhola Sadar Reports to:  Project Manager Contract Duration: Contract Duration:  Fixed-term (10 month), Monthly Salary:  BDT 40000/- Vacancy Type:  Full Time Age Range:  28-45 Years Application Deadline:  17 September 2026 Position Summary The Technical Officer (CCA/DRR) will lead implementation of the project's community and youth-led ecosystem-based adaptation (EbA) platforms and local disaster risk governance components. The role covers formation and strengthening of EbA Action Groups and MetClubs, youth DRR volunteer training, and support to Union and Upazila Disaster Management Committees (UDMC/UzDMC) in integrating EbA into Community Risk Assessments (CRA), Risk Reduction Action Plans (RRAP), and early warning systems. Key Duties and Responsibilities 1. Community & Youth EbA Platform Development Lead formation and capacity building of union-level EbA Action Groups (EAGs), including development of training modules and facilitation of foundational training and quarterly meetings. Establish and support school-based MetClubs, including capacity building on EbA and facilitation of regular school learning sessions. Organize youth (18-25 years) DRR and rescue training in collaboration with the Fire Service and Civil Defence (FSCD). Support participatory ecosystem monitoring, the Community EbA Scorecard, and climate-informed EbA clinics at community level. 2. DRR Governance Strengthening Facilitate Community Risk Assessment (CRA) training for UDMC members and support conduct of CRA and development of Risk Reduction Action Plans (RRAP). Support implementation of prioritized RRAP interventions and community-led ecosystem restoration micro-pilots. Facilitate coordination and review meetings with UDMCs and UzDMCs, and seasonal EbA action planning with local government. 3. Early Warning & Preparedness Support multi-channel early warning dissemination (BAMIS, VMS, Bulk SMS) to ensure timely and accessible hazard information reaches communities. Support assessment and coordination of cyclone shelter reconstruction/rehabilitation activities with local government. 4. Community Engagement & Events Organize the EbA Fair, field days, street film shows, cross-learning visits, and school-based EbA innovation grant pilots. Support organization of the EbA Conference in Bhola with government, practitioners and academia. 5. Coordination, Monitoring & Reporting Coordinate closely with the Union Supervisor and Technical Officer (MEAL) to ensure quality field implementation and data flow. Contribute technical inputs and evidence for donor reports, case studies, and knowledge products. Skills Climate Change Adaptation, Disaster Risk Reduction, Community Mobilization, Government Liaison

কুলিং, ফ্রিজিং এবং প্যাকেজিং পর্যন্ত সম্পূর্ণ প্রক্রিয়া তদারকি করা। প্রতিটি ব্যাচ অনুমোদিত রেসিপি, ফর্মুলেশন ও SOP অনুযায়ী তৈরি হচ্ছে কিনা নিশ্চিত করা। নির্ধারিত সময়ের মধ্যে দৈনিক উৎপাদন লক্ষ্যমাত্রা অর্জন নিশ্চিত করা। পণ্যের মান ও ধারাবাহিকতা নিশ্চিত করা প্রতিটি ব্যাচের স্বাদ, গন্ধ, রং, টেক্সচার, আকার, ওজন ও বাহ্যিক গঠন নির্ধারিত মান অনুযায়ী রাখা। মিটবল ও নাগেটসের সঠিক আকার ও ওজন নিশ্চিত করা। সসেজের ফিলিং, স্টাফিং, কুকিং এবং কেসিং-এর মান পর্যবেক্ষণ করা। মমোর ডো/র‍্যাপার, ফিলিং, ওজন, শেপিং ও সিলিং-এর মান নিশ্চিত করা। নাগেটসের ফর্মিং, ব্যাটার ও ব্রেডিং-এর সঠিক কভারেজ নিশ্চিত করা। ত্রুটিপূর্ণ বা মান-বহির্ভূত পণ্য দ্রুত শনাক্ত করে প্রয়োজনীয় ব্যবস্থা নেওয়া। রেসিপি ও কাঁচামাল নিয়ন্ত্রণ অনুমোদিত রেসিপি অনুযায়ী মাংস, মসলা, স্টার্চ/বাইন্ডার, পানি/বরফ এবং অন্যান্য উপকরণের সঠিক ব্যবহার নিশ্চিত করা। কোনো উপাদান অনুমোদন ছাড়া পরিবর্তন বা অতিরিক্ত ব্যবহার না করা। প্রতিটি ব্যাচে কাঁচামালের ব্যবহার ও উৎপাদিত পণ্যের পরিমাণ রেকর্ড করা। FIFO/FEFO পদ্ধতিতে কাঁচামাল ব্যবহারের বিষয়টি নিশ্চিত করা। উৎপাদন Yield ও Wastage নিয়ন্ত্রণ প্রতি কেজি কাঁচামাল থেকে কত কেজি Finished Product উৎপাদিত হচ্ছে তা পর্যবেক্ষণ করা। প্রতিটি ব্যাচের Yield/Recovery হিসাব রাখা। Meat trimming loss, cooking loss, forming loss, breading loss এবং packaging loss কমানোর ব্যবস্থা নেওয়া। অস্বাভাবিক wastage বা yield variation হলে কারণ শনাক্ত করে ঊর্ধ্বতন কর্মকর্তাকে জানানো। উৎপাদন খরচ কমানোর জন্য কাঁচামালের অপচয় নিয়ন্ত্রণ করা। খাদ্য নিরাপত্তা ও স্বাস্থ্যবিধি কারখানায় GMP, GHP, HACCP এবং প্রতিষ্ঠানের Food Safety SOP অনুসরণ নিশ্চিত করা। উৎপাদন এলাকা, মেশিন, টেবিল, ট্রে, ছুরি ও অন্যান্য food-contact equipment নিয়মিত পরিষ্কার ও জীবাণুমুক্ত রাখা নিশ্চিত করা। কর্মীদের হাত ধোয়া, হেয়ার নেট, মাস্ক, গ্লাভস, এপ্রোন ও প্রয়োজনীয় PPE ব্যবহার নিশ্চিত করা। কাঁচা ও রান্না করা পণ্যের মধ্যে Cross-contamination প্রতিরোধ করা। Chilled এবং Frozen পণ্যের নির্ধারিত তাপমাত্রা বজায় রাখা। উৎপাদনের বিভিন্ন পর্যায়ে প্রয়োজনীয় Temperature Record সংরক্ষণ করা। জনবল পরিচালনা দৈনিক উৎপাদন পরিকল্পনা অনুযায়ী কর্মীদের দায়িত্ব বণ্টন করা। প্রয়োজন অনুযায়ী বিভিন্ন Production Line-এ জনবল নিয়োগ/বণ্টন করা। কর্মীদের কাজের গতি, দক্ষতা, শৃঙ্খলা ও স্বাস্থ্যবিধি পর্যবেক্ষণ করা। নতুন কর্মীদের উৎপাদন প্রক্রিয়া, SOP, Hygiene এবং নিরাপদে মেশিন ব্যবহারের বিষয়ে প্রশিক্ষণ দেওয়া। উৎপাদন লক্ষ্যমাত্রা অর্জনের জন্য জনবলের সর্বোচ্চ কার্যকর ব্যবহার নিশ্চিত করা। মেশিন ও যন্ত্রপাতি তদারকি নিম্নোক্ত মেশিন ও যন্ত্রপাতির সঠিক ব্যবহার ও কার্যক্রম তদারকি করা: Meat Grinder/Mincer Bowl Cutter Meat Mixer Meatball Forming Machine Sausage Stuffer/Filler Momo/Dumpling Forming Machine Nugget Forming Machine Batter & Breading Machine Steamer/Cooking Equipment Fryer (প্রযোজ্য ক্ষেত্রে) Vacuum Packaging/Sealing Machine Blast Freezer/Cold Storage মেশিনে কোনো অস্বাভাবিকতা বা Breakdown দেখা দিলে দ্রুত Maintenance Team/Management-কে অবহিত করা। ফ্রিজিং ও প্যাকেজিং তদারকি উৎপাদিত পণ্য নির্ধারিত সময় ও তাপমাত্রায় দ্রুত Cooling/Freezing করা নিশ্চিত করা। Blast Freezing-এর পর পণ্যের প্রয়োজনীয় Core Temperature অর্জন হয়েছে কিনা নিশ্চিত করা। প্যাকেটের সঠিক ওজন, sealing, batch number, production date এবং expiry date যাচাই করা। Finished Product সঠিক তাপমাত্রায় Cold Storage/Freezer-এ সংরক্ষণ নিশ্চিত করা। উৎপাদন রেকর্ড ও রিপোর্টিং নিয়মিত নিম্নোক্ত রেকর্ড সংরক্ষণ করা: দৈনিক উৎপাদন রিপোর্ট Batch Production Record Raw Material Consumption Finished Product Quantity Batch Yield % Wastage/Rejection Production Downtime Temperature Record Cleaning & Sanitation Record Finished Goods Handover Record প্রতিদিনের উৎপাদন শেষে Production Manager/Management-এর কাছে সংক্ষিপ্ত Daily Production Report প্রদান করা।

Recruitment & Selection Process
আমাদের selection process practical ability-এর ওপর গুরুত্ব দেয়।
Step 1 - Application & Initial Screening
CV/application review-এর পরে shortlisted candidate-দের সঙ্গে initial communication/phone screening করা হতে পারে।
এখানে communication, job understanding, availability এবং basic professional behaviour দেখা হবে।
Step 2 - 3-Day System Familiarization & Practical Assessment
Selected candidate-দের একটি controlled test/UAT system-এ temporary access দেওয়া হবে।
Candidate প্রায় ৩ দিন সময় পাবেন system explore এবং শিখতে।
Sample/test data ব্যবহার করে candidate-কে বিশেষভাবে বুঝতে হবে:
• Search
• Booking/order handling
• Payment-related operation
• Trip management
• Operational records
• Exception handling
এর পরে structured practical assessment নেওয়া হবে।
আমরা শুধু candidate কোথায় click করেন তা দেখব না; candidate কীভাবে situation বুঝে decision নেন সেটিও মূল্যায়ন করা হবে।
Step 3 - Security & Integrity Assessment
Security এবং Integrity আলাদাভাবে evaluate করা হবে।
Scenario-based situation ব্যবহার করে দেখা হতে পারে candidate কীভাবে decision নেন যখন:
• customer urgent
• information incomplete
• booking information পরিবর্তিত
• payment mismatch
• sensitive information requested
• shortcut নেওয়ার pressure
• normal process এবং convenience-এর মধ্যে conflict
Operational assessment ভালো হলেও Security & Integrity standard independently pass করতে হবে।
Critical security/integrity violation final selection থেকে disqualification-এর কারণ হতে পারে।
Step 4 - Final Interview & Selection
Practical এবং Security assessment-এর ফলাফল থেকে সর্বোচ্চ যোগ্য candidate-দের final structured interview-এর জন্য shortlist করা হবে।
Final interview-এ communication, decision-making, independence, accountability, problem-solving এবং future leadership potential মূল্যায়ন করা হবে।
Candidate-এর practical assessment-এর কোনো decision নিয়েও আলোচনা করা হতে পারে এবং candidate-কে নিজের reasoning explain করতে হতে পারে।
Final selection-এর আগে প্রয়োজন অনুযায়ী reference, identity এবং employment/background information যাচাই করা হতে পারে।
আমরা দ্রুত vacancy পূরণ করার চেয়ে সঠিক মানুষ নির্বাচনকে বেশি গুরুত্ব দিই।
যারা নতুন system দ্রুত শিখতে চান, independentভাবে problem solve করতে পারেন, মানুষের সঙ্গে professionalভাবে communicate করতে পারেন এবং ভবিষ্যতে বড় operational responsibility নিতে আগ্রহী-তাদের আবেদন করতে উৎসাহিত করা হচ্ছে।

job_description: Department:  QC / Laboratory / R&D Reports To : QA/QC Manager / Technical Manager Main Purpose of the Position To perform laboratory testing, quality control, product development, formulation trials, and technical evaluation of construction admixtures and cement grinding aids, ensuring that raw materials and finished products consistently meet company specifications and required performance standards. Raw Material Testing Inspect and test incoming raw materials according to approved specifications. Check physical and chemical properties of raw materials used for admixture and grinding-aid production. Approve or reject raw materials based on test results and company specifications. Maintain complete records of raw-material testing. Evaluate new raw materials and alternative suppliers. Report any abnormal or out-of-specification raw material to the QA/QC Manager. Construction Admixture Quality Control Test finished admixture products according to approved specifications and SOPs. Perform tests such as appearance, density/specific gravity, pH, solids content, viscosity, and other applicable parameters. Conduct concrete/mortar performance tests where required. Check admixture dosage and its effect on concrete performance. Evaluate workability/slump, slump retention, setting time, water reduction, and compressive strength as applicable to each product. Check batch-to-batch consistency. Release finished products only after required QC tests are completed and approved. Cement Grinding Aid Testing Conduct laboratory evaluation of cement grinding-aid products. Test different grinding-aid formulations and dosages. Evaluate the effect of grinding aid on cement grinding performance. Monitor cement properties such as fineness, setting time, strength development, and other applicable parameters. Conduct comparative trials against existing products or competitor/reference products when required. Maintain records of grinding-aid trials and test results. Assist the technical team in optimizing grinding-aid dosage and formulation. Product Development & R&D Assist in development of new construction admixture and cement grinding-aid formulations. Conduct laboratory-scale formulation trials. Optimize formulations for performance, stability, and cost. Evaluate new chemicals and raw materials for potential use. Maintain formulation and trial records. Conduct stability and compatibility studies where required. Support scale-up from laboratory trial to production batch. Keep formulation information confidential. Production Quality Control Collect samples from production batches according to approved sampling procedures. Perform in-process and final-product testing. Communicate laboratory results to the Production and QA/QC teams. Identify quality deviations during production. Assist in investigating the causes of quality problems. Recommend corrective action based on laboratory findings. Monitor consistency between laboratory trial batches and production batches. Concrete & Mortar Testing Prepare concrete/mortar test mixes according to approved mix designs. Conduct admixture dosage optimization. Evaluate slump and slump retention. Monitor setting time where applicable. Prepare specimens for compressive-strength testing. Compare performance at different admixture dosages and formulations. Maintain proper sample identification and testing records. Assist during customer/site trials when required. Cement Testing Conduct laboratory cement testing related to grinding-aid performance. Prepare cement samples for laboratory evaluation. Test relevant cement properties according to approved methods. Compare cement performance with and without grinding aid. Maintain accurate records of cement and grinding-aid trials. Assist in troubleshooting cement-performance issues. Laboratory Management Maintain laboratory cleanliness and proper housekeeping. Maintain laboratory equipment in good working condition. Check calibration status of laboratory instruments. Arrange calibration and maintenance when required. Maintain chemicals, reagents, consumables, and laboratory equipment inventory. Ensure proper labeling and storage of chemicals and samples. Maintain retain samples as required. Ensure proper disposal of chemical and laboratory waste. Documentation & Reporting Maintain daily laboratory test records. Prepare raw-material and finished-product test reports. Prepare Certificates of Analysis (COA) where applicable. Maintain batch-wise QC records. Maintain R&D formulation and trial records. Prepare laboratory trial reports and comparative test reports. Immediately report abnormal or out-of-specification results to management. Maintain proper traceability of samples and test results. Customer Technical Support Assist in investigating customer complaints related to product performance. Analyze customer samples where required. Support technical/customer service teams during field trials. Assist with admixture dosage recommendations based on laboratory results. Participate in customer cement/grinding-aid trials when required. Prepare technical test reports for customer trials. Safety Responsibilities Follow laboratory safety procedures and company HSE requirements. Use appropriate PPE when handling chemicals. Handle, store, and dispose of chemicals safely. Maintain Safety Data Sheets (SDS/MSDS) where required. Immediately report laboratory accidents, chemical spills, or unsafe conditions. Ensure laboratory activities are conducted in a safe and controlled manner. Key Performance Indicators (KPIs) The Lab Chemist will be evaluated based on: Accuracy and reliability of laboratory test results. Timely completion of QC testing. Consistency of finished-product quality. Successful formulation and R&D trials. Reduction of production quality problems. Effectiveness of technical troubleshooting. Accuracy and completeness of laboratory documentation. Proper maintenance and calibration of laboratory equipment. Successful support of customer/site trials. বজায় রাখা। ব্যবসায়িক পণ্যের সম্ভাব্য ক্রয়ের উৎস এবং বিক্রয়ের বাজার সম্পর্কে উদ্যোক্তাকে সামগ্রিক ধারণা প্রদান করা। সম্ভাব্য ব্যবসায়িক মূলধনের পরিমাণ বিশ্লেষণ করা, অর্থায়নের সুযোগ ও শর্তাবলী নিয়ে উদ্যোক্তাদের সাথে আলোচনা করা, এবং নির্বাচিত উদ্যোগসমূহের জন্য প্রবৃদ্ধি মূলধন ও ইক্যুইটি বিনিয়োগের মূল্যায়ন, নথিভুক্তকরণ ও পর্যবেক্ষণে সহায়তা করা। ব্যবসা পরিচালনার জন্য প্রাসঙ্গিক সকল আইনগত কাগজপত্র (ট্রেড লাইসেন্স/টিআইএন/বিআইএন/আইআরসি/ইআরসি/ব্যাংক হিসাব লেনদেন ইত্যাদি) সম্পর্কে উদ্যোক্তাদের তথ্য প্রদান করা। সম্ভাবনাময় উদ্যোক্তাদের ব্যবসায়িক প্রস্তাবনা প্রস্তুত ও উপস্থাপন করা। কার্যকর পোর্টফোলিও ব্যবস্থাপনার জন্য উদ্যোগের কার্যক্রম, মূলধন ব্যবহার, উদ্যোক্তার অগ্রগতি এবং মূল ব্যবসায়িক সূচকসমূহ পর্যবেক্ষণ করা। মূলধন আদায় এবং বিনিয়োগকৃত তহবিলের যথাযথ ব্যবহার নিশ্চিত করতে পোর্টফোলিওর কার্যক্রম পর্যবেক্ষণ করা এবং উদ্যোক্তাদের সাথে যোগাযোগ রক্ষা করা। উদ্যোগ পোর্টফোলিওর মধ্যে ঝুঁকি, ব্যবসায়িক চ্যালেঞ্জ এবং সহায়তার প্রয়োজনীয়তা চিহ্নিত করা এবং প্রয়োজনে বিষয়টি উর্ধ্বতন কর্তৃপক্ষের নজরে আনা। প্রশিক্ষণ, উদ্যোক্তা উন্নয়ন কর্মশালা, মেন্টরিং কার্যক্রম, নেটওয়ার্কিং ইভেন্ট এবং ইকোসিস্টেম সংশ্লিষ্ট উদ্যোগ সমন্বয় ও সহায়তা করা। উদ্যোগের অগ্রগতি পর্যবেক্ষণ এবং ব্যবসায়িক প্রবৃদ্ধি, চ্যালেঞ্জ ও সহায়তার প্রয়োজনীয়তা নথিভুক্ত করার জন্য নিয়মিত মাঠপর্যায়ে পরিদর্শন করা। উদ্যোক্তা সম্পৃক্তকরণ, পোর্টফোলিও কার্যক্রম, মূলধন ব্যবহার, মাঠ পরিদর্শন এবং কর্মসূচির কার্যক্রমের যথাযথ রেকর্ড সংরক্ষণ করা। নিয়মিত মাঠ প্রতিবেদন, উদ্যোগের কার্যক্রম হালনাগাদ, কেস স্টাডি এবং কার্যক্রম সংক্রান্ত নথিপত্র প্রস্তুত করা। কর্মসূচির কার্যক্রম সময়মতো ও কার্যকরভাবে বাস্তবায়ন নিশ্চিত করতে অভ্যন্তরীণ দলসমূহের সাথে ঘনিষ্ঠভাবে সমন্বয় সাধন করা। লাইন ম্যানেজার বা ব্যবস্থাপনা কর্তৃক অর্পিত অন্য যেকোনো কাজ সম্পাদন করা।

job_description: ABOUT OLYMPIA Olympia International is an international apparel business working across the UK, Europe, North America and the Middle East. We specialise in developing and supplying commercial fashion products for major international retailers, particularly within the off-price sector. Our product categories include T-shirts, polos, sweatshirts, hoodies, Henleys, knit tops and other casualwear across a portfolio of owned and licensed brands. We operate through teams in London and Bangladesh and work with a network of manufacturing partners across Bangladesh, China and other sourcing markets. As the business continues to grow, we are looking for an experienced Knit Merchandising Manager to take responsibility for our knit merchandising operation in Bangladesh. THE ROLE This is a senior, hands-on merchandising position responsible for managing the complete knit product and order lifecycle — from initial development and costing through sampling, order placement, production and final shipment. The successful candidate will be expected to take ownership rather than simply follow up orders. You will manage and develop the knit merchandising team in Bangladesh while working closely with Olympia's London Brand Leads, Bangladesh Product & Design team, garment technologists, factories, fabric mills, quality teams and production teams. A major part of the role is ensuring that information moves quickly and accurately between customers, the London office and factories. The objective is simple: Develop the right product, at the right price, place it with the right factory and deliver it on time and to the required quality standard. WHAT WE ARE LOOKING FOR We are looking for someone with approximately 8–12+ years' experience in knit apparel merchandising, including meaningful experience managing a merchandising team. Strong experience in products such as: - T-shirts - Polos - Sweatshirts - Hoodies - Henleys - Jersey tops - Fashion casualwear Experience working with international retailers, brands, buying offices or sourcing companies is strongly preferred. The successful candidate should demonstrate: - Excellent knowledge of knit garment production. - Strong fabric and garment construction knowledge. - Strong costing and price-negotiation ability. - Excellent understanding of critical-path management. - Strong factory management skills. - Ability to manage multiple customers and large numbers of styles simultaneously. - Strong problem-solving skills. - Excellent written and spoken English. - Strong Excel/reporting ability. - Ability to manage and develop junior team members. - Confidence communicating directly with overseas commercial teams and senior management. THE PERSON WE WANT Olympia is a fast-moving entrepreneurial business. We therefore need someone who thinks beyond the traditional merchandising role. We want someone who: Takes ownership. If something is going wrong, they act rather than wait for instructions. Communicates early. Bad news communicated early can normally be managed. Problems hidden until the last minute cannot. Understands product. They can look at a garment and understand how it should be made, where it should be made and approximately what it should cost. Is commercially minded. They understand that every sourcing and production decision ultimately affects whether Olympia can win and retain business. Can prioritise. Not every problem has the same commercial importance. Develops people. We want someone capable of building a strong merchandising department underneath them. Is comfortable with change. Olympia is growing and our systems, customers, factories and product categories will continue to evolve. SUCCESS IN THIS ROLE Within the first 6–12 months, we would expect the successful candidate to have: - Full control and visibility of the knit development and production pipeline. - Established clear accountability within the merchandising team. - Reduced late developments and production surprises. - Improved development turnaround times. - Strengthened factory costing and negotiation. - Improved communication between Bangladesh and London. - Developed stronger factory allocation and capacity planning. - Created reliable reporting for all live developments and orders. - Built a merchandising structure capable of supporting significant growth. This is an important leadership position within Olympia's Bangladesh operation and offers the opportunity to play a major role in the continued development of our international apparel business. KEY RESPONSIBILITIES 1. Product Development & Sampling Manage the knit development pipeline across multiple customers and brands. company_business:
**Company Introduction** - Amzad Food began its journey in November 2021 with the goal of providing natural food to people across Bangladesh, directly from the field. The company was founded by Almas Hossain, who, while studying Islamic History and Civilization, established Amzad Food with the aim of helping people access healthy and natural food.

**Product Launch** - In 2021, Amzad Food introduced its first product: Premium Honey Nat. This high-quality, delicious honey quickly gained the trust of our customers, and today, we have over a lakh (100,000) satisfied customers. Alhamdulillah, we are grateful to be able to provide healthy, natural, and high-quality food to our valued customers.

**Current Products** - Alhamdulillah, with the love and demand of millions of people, Amzad Food has expanded its product range. Along with Honey Nat, the company now offers a variety of products, including honey, ghee, dates, sugarcane jaggery, date jaggery, mangoes, and various seasonal and popular items.

**Customer Service** - Customer satisfaction is the primary goal of Amzad Food. To ensure our customers are satisfied, we offer a return policy. If any customer is dissatisfied with a product for any reason, we arrange for the return of the product within 24 hours and provide a cashback. Our friendly and efficient customer support team is available seven days a week to address any product-related issues.

**Our Mission** - Our mission is to source completely chemical-free food from remote rural areas in all 64 districts of Bangladesh and deliver it to our customers. We focus on providing natural and safe food, and we are committed to being one of the leading companies offering chemical-free food. We aim to deliver safe, natural, and chemical-free food directly to your doorstep.

**Future Plans** - Our future plan is to donate a large portion of Amzad Food`s profits to help the poor, homeless, and orphaned children. In addition, we plan to build mosques and madrasas in rural areas, a goal that has been part of the company`s mission since its inception.

**Conclusion** - Safe food is your right. We seek your prayers and love. Experience healthy and natural food with Amzad Food.

job_description: A. Business Performance Analysis Analyze overall business performance against approved  sales, revenue, volume, profitability, and operational targets . Prepare daily, weekly, monthly, quarterly, and annual business performance reports for management. Develop and monitor business KPIs for different functions, business units, products, territories, and sales channels. Identify performance gaps, emerging trends, and key business risks and provide recommendations to management. Conduct variance analysis between  actual vs. budget, actual vs. target, and current vs. previous periods . Track key performance indicators and highlight areas requiring immediate management attention. B. Sales & Revenue Analytics Analyze sales performance of concrete blocks and related construction products by  product, customer, territory, project, dealer/distributor, and sales channel . Monitor sales volume, revenue, average selling price, discounts, customer mix, and contribution margins. Analyze sales pipeline, order booking, pending orders, delivery status, and customer conversion. Identify high-performing and underperforming products, customers, territories, and sales personnel. Support management in setting realistic sales targets based on historical performance, market demand, capacity, and business projections. Prepare sales forecasting and demand projections for management review. C. Product & Profitability Analysis Analyze the profitability of different concrete block products, sizes, specifications, and product categories. Evaluate  selling price, production cost, raw material cost, logistics cost, overheads, and contribution margin . Conduct product-wise and customer-wise profitability analysis. Support management in evaluating pricing strategies and identifying opportunities for margin improvement. Analyze the financial and commercial impact of discounts, promotional offers, credit terms, and pricing changes. D. Production & Manufacturing Analytics Analyze production capacity, utilization, output, downtime, rejection, wastage, and productivity. Compare planned production with actual production and identify key reasons for deviations. Monitor production efficiency and identify opportunities for improving  capacity utilization and manufacturing productivity . Analyze material consumption and production yield against established standards. Work with Production and Factory teams to identify operational inefficiencies and recommend data-driven improvement initiatives. E. Cost & Operational Analysis Analyze major business costs including  raw materials, energy, labor, transportation, packaging, maintenance, and other operating expenses . Identify cost trends and opportunities for cost reduction without compromising product quality. Conduct cost-benefit analysis for proposed operational and commercial initiatives. Analyze transportation and distribution costs by customer, route, territory, and delivery volume. Support management in evaluating the financial impact of operational improvement projects. F. Market & Competitor Analysis Conduct market research related to the  concrete block, construction materials, real estate, infrastructure, and building products industries . Monitor market demand, industry trends, construction activity, competitor pricing, product offerings, and market positioning. Collect and analyze competitor information regarding  price, product specifications, quality, distribution network, customer segments, and market practices . Identify new market opportunities, customer segments, geographic markets, and potential business areas. Prepare market intelligence reports and strategic recommendations for management. G. Business Planning & Forecasting Support preparation of annual business plans, budgets, sales forecasts, and strategic plans. Develop business forecasts based on historical data, market trends, production capacity, customer demand, and management assumptions. Conduct scenario analysis such as  best case, base case, and worst case  for major business decisions. Support management in evaluating new products, markets, projects, investments, and business expansion opportunities. Prepare business cases and financial/operational analysis for proposed initiatives. H. Management Reporting & MIS Develop and maintain accurate  Management Information System (MIS)  reports and dashboards. Prepare management dashboards covering sales, production, inventory, receivables, profitability, costs, and operational KPIs. Automate recurring reports and reduce manual reporting through appropriate analytical tools. Ensure data accuracy, consistency, completeness, and timely submission of reports. Present key findings and recommendations to senior management in a clear and concise manner. I. Data Analytics & Dashboard Development Collect, consolidate, validate, and analyze data from multiple business functions. Develop analytical models, dashboards, scorecards, and performance trackers using tools such as  Advanced Excel, Power BI, SQL, ERP/MIS systems , or other relevant analytical platforms. Establish standardized reporting formats and data definitions across departments. Identify data quality issues and coordinate with relevant departments for correction. Continuously improve business reporting and analytics capabilities. J. Cross-Functional Business Support Work closely with Sales, Marketing, Production, Finance, Supply Chain, Procurement, Commercial, Quality, HR, and Operations teams. Translate business requirements into analytical reports, dashboards, and actionable insights. Participate in cross-functional meetings and provide relevant business data and analysis. Support process improvement initiatives through data-driven analysis. Follow up on agreed management actions and monitor their business impact. K. Strategic & Management Support Provide analytical support to senior management for strategic and operational decision-making. Conduct  feasibility studies, business case analysis, ROI analysis, break-even analysis, and sensitivity analysis  as required. Identify opportunities for revenue growth, cost optimization, productivity improvement, and process enhancement. Prepare presentations and executive summaries for management meetings. Perform special business analysis and management assignments as required.
skills_required: Business Analysis,Compliance Audit,Corporate Finance,Cost and profit analysis,Data Management,Financial Analysis,MS Office,Presentation and Reporting,Sales Analysis

Ethnic minorities are taken under special priority along with other vulnerable classes prone to environmental, social and climatic degradation. job_description: জেড এক্স ওয়াই ইন্টারন্যাশনাল, একটি মাল্টি-ন্যাশনাল বায়িং অফিস, এর নিট স্যাম্পলিং সেকশনের জন্য জ্যাকার্ড মেশিন পরিচালনায় অভিজ্ঞ কর্তব্যপরায়ণ, নিবেদিত এবং পরিশ্রমী জ্যাকার্ড অপারেটর আবশ্যক। জ্যাকার্ড অপারেটরের প্রধান দায়িত্ব-কর্তব্য সমূহ ও আবেদনের ন্যূনতম যোগ্যতা নিম্নে উল্লেখ করা হলঃ কাজের উদ্দেশ্য:  জ্যাকার্ড অপারেটর ক্রেতার চাহিদা ও ডিজাইন অনুযায়ী জ্যাকার্ড সোয়েটারের স্যাম্পল তৈরি ও ডেভেলপ করেন। তিনি জ্যাকার্ড নিটিং মেশিন পরিচালনা, ডিজাইন ও টেকনিক্যাল নির্দেশনা অনুসরণ, স্যাম্পলের গুণগত মান নিশ্চিত এবং সমস্যা সমাধান করেন। পাশাপাশি ডিজাইন, মার্চেন্ডাইজিং ও প্রোডাকশন টিমের সঙ্গে সমন্বয় করে সময়মতো স্যাম্পল ডেভেলপমেন্ট এবং মেশিনের বেসিক সেটআপ ও মেইনটেন্যান্সে সহায়তা করেন। দায়িত্ব-কর্তব্য সমূহ: ক্রেতার চাহিদা ও ডিজাইন অনুযায়ী জ্যাকার্ড সোয়েটারের স্যাম্পল তৈরি ও ডেভেলপ করা। স্যাম্পল ডেভেলপমেন্টের জন্য জ্যাকার্ড নিটিং মেশিন পরিচালনা করা। জ্যাকার্ড ডিজাইন, প্যাটার্ন, আর্টওয়ার্ক ও টেকনিক্যাল নির্দেশনা বুঝে কাজ করা। বিভিন্ন ধরনের সুতা, স্ট্রাকচার, রং ও নিটিং টেকনিক ব্যবহার করে নতুন স্যাম্পল তৈরি করা। সময়মতো স্যাম্পল সম্পন্ন করতে ডিজাইন, মার্চেন্ডাইজিং ও প্রোডাকশন টিমের সঙ্গে সমন্বয় করা। স্যাম্পলের মাপ, স্টিচ স্ট্রাকচার, রং, ফিনিশিং ও গুণগত মান নিশ্চিত করা। নিটিং ও স্যাম্পল ডেভেলপমেন্টের সমস্যা চিহ্নিত করে প্রয়োজনীয় সমাধান ও মেশিন অ্যাডজাস্টমেন্ট করা। স্যাম্পল ডেভেলপমেন্ট ও মেশিন সেটিংসের সঠিক রেকর্ড সংরক্ষণ করা। মেশিন সেটআপ, অ্যাডজাস্টমেন্ট, বেসিক মেইনটেন্যান্স, ট্রাবলশুটিং ও ছোটখাটো মেরামত করা। বড় ধরনের মেশিন সমস্যার ক্ষেত্রে টেকনিশিয়ানের সঙ্গে সমন্বয় করা। স্যাম্পলের গুণগত মান উন্নত করা এবং ডেভেলপমেন্ট সময় কমাতে সহায়তা করা।

job_description: About ASA:  ASA is one of the largest and globally leading recognised microfinance institutions (MFIs) in Bangladesh. With over 3,000 branches nationwide, ASA serves millions of its members through micro-credit products, MSME loan products, savings products, client welfare fund services, and social activities. ASA operates a fully self-sustaining, donor-free model and is renowned for its in-house digital ecosystem—the ASA Microfinance Management System (AMMS)—which fully automates and is a real-time online system. Job Context:  The  Assistant Director (Finance & MIS)  is responsible for steering the financial accounting, reporting, and compliance functions of ASA. This role is the primary custodian of the organization’s financial integrity, tasked with preparing statutory and management accounts, leading audit engagements, ensuring strict regulatory compliance (MRA), and generating strategic financial insights. The position bridges the gap between raw financial data and actionable intelligence, ensuring that all reporting—from daily cash flows to annual budgets—is accurate, timely, and aligned with ASA’s operational scale. Key Responsibilities 1. Financial Accounting, Accounts Preparation & Policy Stewardship Oversee the preparation and consolidation of monthly, quarterly, and annual financial statements in compliance with Accounting Standards and ASA policies. Lead the annual budgeting process of field operations, including the preparation of detailed financial forecasts, cash flow projections, and variance analysis for extensive field operations. Prepare, review, and finalize reconciliations, general ledger entries, and fixed assets. Ensure the accurate closing of accounts at period-ends and maintain a robust chart of accounts that reflects the complexities of microfinance operations. Contribute to reviewing, evaluating, and updating ASA’s accounting manuals, policies, and operational guidelines. Proceed with rectification, amendments, or additions if required to ensure alignment with evolving regulatory requirements, industry best practices, and organizational changes. Ensure that the ASA Accounting Manual is consistently maintained, updated, and comprehensively reflects current accounting frameworks, MRA directives, and internal control protocols. 2. Audit Facilitation & Compliance Act as the primary point of contact for internal and external auditors during annual and special audits. Coordinate the preparation of audit schedules, providing all required documentation and explanations to auditors on time. Review audit findings and implement corrective action plans to address recommendations and strengthen internal controls. Ensure the organization’s financial operations adhere to regulatory standards, specifically the Microcredit Regulatory Authority (MRA) Act, rules and guidelines, and government laws. Review ASA’s manual and policies, proceed to rectification/amendment/addition of policies and guidelines (if required), and ensure the ASA Accounting Manual is up to date 3. Regulatory & Statutory Reporting Prepare and submit accurate financial and Regulatory reports to the MRA by following organizational policy and ensuring strict adherence to prescribed formats and deadlines. Compile reports for government bodies and international partners as required, ensuring transparency and regulatory compliance. 4. Financial Analysis & Internal Reporting Analyze financial data to identify cost-saving opportunities, optimize resource allocation, and monitor operational efficiency. Prepare detailed portfolio quality reports, delinquency analyses, and operational efficiency metrics for senior management. Develop and automate financial dashboards (using Power BI and advanced Excel) for real-time decision-making, transforming complex data into actionable strategies. 5. Field Operations Advisory & Support Provide proactive strategic advisory and technical support to field operations teams to enhance financial discipline and operational accuracy at the grassroots level. Guide branch-level staff on data correction and reconciliation, ensuring all transactional data entered into the core MIS aligns with physical cash and client records. Advise field management on robust accounting practices, internal control mechanisms, and strict adherence to MRA compliance standards. Collaborate with field teams on fund planning and liquidity management, ensuring optimal cash flow forecasting and efficient utilization of funds across branches to prevent shortages or idle surpluses. Conduct regular field visits and remote reviews to identify systemic gaps in branch-level financial processes, offering hands-on corrective action plans and training to branch managers and field accountants. 6. MIS & Data Management Ensure, in collaboration with IT, the seamless flow of financial and operational data. Ensure, in collaboration with IT,  data integrity, security, and accuracy within the software, with a specific focus on financial data validation. Identify gaps in data infrastructure and collaborate with IT to implement system upgrades that enhance financial reporting and automation. 7. Leadership & Team Management Lead, mentor, and evaluate the performance of the Finance and MIS teams, building their capacity in financial controls and systems. Act as the primary liaison between the finance, IT, and field operations departments to ensure cohesive data and financial strategies. In addition, perform any other duties and responsibilities assigned by the Management or authority.

job_description: Job Purpose:  The Admin and Logistics Assistant is responsible for providing efficient administrative, logistical, and operational support to ensure the smooth implementation of organizational and project activities. The position supports office administration, procurement, inventory and asset management, transportation, travel arrangements, event logistics, documentation, and coordination with staff, suppliers, and other relevant stakeholders. The incumbent will ensure that administrative and logistical activities are conducted in accordance with the organization's policies, donor requirements, financial procedures, procurement guidelines, and applicable laws and regulations. Key Responsibilities Administrative Support Provide day-to-day administrative support to the project and organizational team. Maintain proper filing systems for administrative, procurement, logistics, and operational documents. Receive, register, distribute, and maintain incoming and outgoing correspondence. Prepare letters, notices, meeting minutes, reports, and other administrative documents as required. Maintain office records, registers, and databases. Support the preparation and organization of meetings, workshops, training sessions, and other project events. Ensure the availability of office supplies and maintain proper records of their use. Assist in maintaining staff attendance, leave records, and other administrative documentation. Support communication and coordination among project staff and relevant departments. Logistics and Transportation Management Arrange transportation for staff, project participants, visitors, and official activities. Prepare and maintain vehicle movement schedules and transport requests. Coordinate with drivers and transport service providers to ensure timely and efficient transportation services. Support travel arrangements, including accommodation, tickets, and travel documentation, where applicable. Ensure logistical arrangements for field visits, monitoring activities, workshops, training, and meetings. Maintain records of vehicle use, fuel consumption, maintenance, and travel movements where assigned. Ensure that all logistics arrangements comply with organizational policies and approved budgets. Procurement Support Assist in the procurement of goods, services, and materials required for project implementation. Collect quotations and support the preparation of comparative statements. Maintain procurement files and documentation in accordance with organizational and donor procedures. Coordinate with suppliers and service providers regarding delivery schedules and required documentation. Assist in preparing purchase requisitions, purchase orders, and goods received documentation. Ensure that procured goods and services meet required specifications and quality standards. Support transparent, fair, and cost-effective procurement processes. Asset and Inventory Management Maintain updated inventories of office equipment, furniture, supplies, and project assets. Support the proper labeling and tagging of organizational assets. Conduct regular physical verification of assets and inventory. Maintain stock registers and issue records for office and project materials. Ensure the safe storage and proper management of supplies and equipment. Report damaged, lost, or obsolete assets to the appropriate supervisor. Support asset handover and disposal processes in accordance with organizational policies. Workshop, Training, and Event Logistics Arrange venues, refreshments, accommodation, transportation, and necessary materials for workshops and training sessions. Prepare participant lists, attendance sheets, and logistical documentation. Ensure that training and workshop materials are available before the event. Coordinate with facilitators, participants, vendors, and service providers. Support the proper documentation of logistical expenses and supporting documents. Compliance and Documentation Ensure that administrative and logistics activities comply with organizational policies and procedures. Maintain complete and accurate supporting documents for procurement and logistics transactions. Support internal and external audits by providing required administrative and logistical documentation. Follow donor rules and regulations related to procurement, asset management, and operational support. Maintain confidentiality and ensure the secure handling of organizational information. Coordination Responsibilities The Admin and Logistics Assistant will work closely with: Project Manager Admin and Finance Officer Finance and Accounts Team Program and Project Staff Procurement Committee Drivers and Support Staff Suppliers and Service Providers Government and Local Authorities, when required Additional Responsibilities The duties and responsibilities listed above are not exhaustive. The Admin and Logistics Assistant may be required to perform other relevant duties assigned by the supervisor or management in support of the effective implementation of organizational and project activities.

অন্যান্য স্বাস্থ্যগত সমস্যার প্রাথমিক লক্ষণ শনাক্ত করা। রোগ প্রতিরোধ, রোগ নির্ণয়, চিকিৎসা ও অন্যান্য স্বাস্থ্যসেবার জন্য ভেটেরিনারি চিকিৎসক/বিশেষজ্ঞদের সঙ্গে সমন্বয় করা। টিকাদান, চিকিৎসা, অসুস্থতা, আঘাত ও অন্যান্য স্বাস্থ্যসংক্রান্ত কার্যক্রমের সঠিক রেকর্ড সংরক্ষণ করা। প্রজনন ও উৎপাদনশীলতা ব্যবস্থাপনা প্রজনন চক্র, হিট ডিটেকশন, বাছুর প্রসব এবং কৃত্রিম প্রজনন (AI) কার্যক্রমের সঠিক রেকর্ড সংরক্ষণ job_description: Job Summary: The  Physiotherapist  is responsible for helping patients recover from illness, injury, or surgery through physical therapy and rehabilitation. The position involves providing treatment to both  in-patients (IPD) —such as bed-bound or post-surgical patients—and  out-patients (OPD) —those visiting the physiotherapy center for ongoing care. The role includes assessing patients, planning and delivering therapy sessions, monitoring progress, and promoting recovery through exercise, manual therapy, and use of physiotherapy equipment. The physiotherapist works closely with doctors, nurses, and other healthcare professionals to ensure effective, safe, and patient-centered rehabilitation. Key Duties and Responsibilities: IPD (In-Patient Department) Visit patients in wards and provide physiotherapy at the bedside. Help post-operative patients start early movement and breathing exercises. Assist patients with walking, transfers, and safe mobility. Prevent complications like muscle stiffness or lung problems. Work with doctors and nurses to plan patient recovery. Prepare patients for discharge and guide them for home exercises. OPD (Out-Patient Department) Treat patients who come to the physiotherapy center with pain or mobility problems. Plan and provide exercises for back pain, arthritis, stroke, sports injury, etc. Use physiotherapy machines (ultrasound, heat therapy, TENS, etc.) when needed. Teach home exercise programs and posture correction. Keep records of patient progress and follow-up visits. General Responsibilities Assess and evaluate each patient before starting treatment. Keep detailed records of treatment given and progress made. Report patient progress to doctors and the head of the department. Maintain cleanliness and safety of physiotherapy equipment. Attend departmental meetings and training when required. Follow hospital rules, infection control, and patient confidentiality policies. Provide compassionate and respectful care to all patients.

সার্বিক নিরাপত্তা নিশ্চিত করা, নিরাপত্তাকর্মীদের কার্যক্রম পরিচালনা ও তদারকি করা এবং প্রতিষ্ঠানের কর্মকর্তা-কর্মচারী, সম্পদ, পণ্য ও স্থাপনার নিরাপত্তা বজায় রাখা। প্রধান দায়িত্বসমূহ কারখানার সার্বিক নিরাপত্তা ব্যবস্থা পরিকল্পনা, পরিচালনা ও নিয়মিত তদারকি করা। নিরাপত্তাকর্মীদের ডিউটি রোস্টার, পোস্টিং ও শিফট পরিচালনা করা। কারখানার প্রধান গেট, প্রবেশপথ, সীমানা, গুদাম, অফিস ও গুরুত্বপূর্ণ স্থাপনার নিরাপত্তা নিশ্চিত করা। কর্মকর্তা, কর্মচারী, শ্রমিক, দর্শনার্থী ও যানবাহনের প্রবেশ-বাহির নিয়ন্ত্রণ ও রেকর্ড সংরক্ষণ করা। অনুমোদন ব্যতীত কোনো ব্যক্তি, যানবাহন, মালামাল বা পণ্য কারখানায় প্রবেশ/বাহির হতে না পারে তা নিশ্চিত করা। পণ্য, কাঁচামাল, যন্ত্রপাতি ও অন্যান্য কোম্পানির সম্পদ চুরি, ক্ষতি বা অননুমোদিত অপসারণ প্রতিরোধ করা। CCTV, গেট পাস, ভিজিটর রেজিস্টার ও অন্যান্য নিরাপত্তা ব্যবস্থা নিয়মিত পর্যবেক্ষণ করা। নিরাপত্তাকর্মীদের নিয়ম-শৃঙ্খলা, পোশাক, ডিউটি ও আচরণবিধি নিশ্চিত করা। নিরাপত্তাকর্মীদের নিয়মিত ব্রিফিং, প্যারেড/মাস্টার প্যারেড ও প্রয়োজনীয় প্রশিক্ষণের ব্যবস্থা করা। কারখানায় কোনো অনাকাঙ্ক্ষিত ঘটনা, চুরি, অগ্নিকাণ্ড, সংঘর্ষ, অনুপ্রবেশ বা নিরাপত্তা ঝুঁকি দেখা দিলে দ্রুত ব্যবস্থা গ্রহণ করা। জরুরি পরিস্থিতিতে কোম্পানির নির্ধারিত Emergency Response Plan অনুযায়ী কার্যক্রম পরিচালনা করা। স্থানীয় প্রশাসন, আইনশৃঙ্খলা রক্ষাকারী বাহিনী ও সংশ্লিষ্ট কর্তৃপক্ষের সঙ্গে প্রয়োজন অনুযায়ী সমন্বয় করা। শ্রমিক অসন্তোষ, বিরোধ, অননুমোদিত প্রবেশ বা অন্যান্য নিরাপত্তাজনিত পরিস্থিতি শান্তিপূর্ণ ও পেশাদারভাবে নিয়ন্ত্রণে সহায়তা করা। প্রতিদিনের নিরাপত্তা পরিস্থিতি এবং গুরুত্বপূর্ণ ঘটনা সম্পর্কে ঊর্ধ্বতন কর্তৃপক্ষকে রিপোর্ট করা। নিরাপত্তা সংক্রান্ত যেকোনো ঝুঁকি শনাক্ত করে তাৎক্ষণিকভাবে কর্তৃপক্ষকে অবহিত করা এবং প্রতিরোধমূলক ব্যবস্থা গ্রহণ করা। নিয়মিত Security Inspection/Patrolling পরিচালনা করা এবং দুর্বল নিরাপত্তা পয়েন্ট চিহ্নিত করা। কারখানার নিরাপত্তা নীতিমালা ও কোম্পানির নির্দেশনা যথাযথভাবে বাস্তবায়ন করা। প্রয়োজনে বিভিন্ন জেলার কারখানা/প্রকল্পে অবস্থান করে দায়িত্ব পালন করা এবং কোম্পানির প্রয়োজন অনুযায়ী বদলি/ভ্রমণে সম্মত থাকা।

Business: Handicap International (HI) is an international aid organization specializing in the field of disability. Non-governmental, non-religious, non-political, and non-profit making works alongside persons with disabilities and other vulnerable groups, whatever the context, assisting and supporting them in their efforts to become self-reliant. Since its creation, the organization has set up programmes in approximately 60 countries and intervened in many emergencies. Operational Thematic: Livelihood, Health and Rehabilitation, Protection, Inclusion, Education, and Atlas Logistics.

Presently, HI Bangladesh is implementing projects on integrating disability in community-based disaster risk reduction and response; economic empowerment of extremely poor persons with disabilities; mainstreaming disability in livelihood interventions; support to refugees and surrounding communities, capacity building of professional associations; and support to disabled people`s organizations, among others.

job_description: Position Overview The CCTV Technician will be responsible for  electrical wiring, CAT6 network cabling, CCTV camera installation, testing, commissioning, troubleshooting, preventive maintenance, and technical support . The technician must complete all work safely, neatly, professionally, and according to approved drawings, project specifications, client requirements, and company standards. Key Job Responsibilities Electrical Wiring & Power Connection Carry out electrical wiring for CCTV cameras, NVR/DVR, network switches, VMS servers, racks, monitors, and related security equipment. Install and connect electrical power cables from designated power sources to CCTV equipment. Install and connect MCBs, distribution boards, power sockets, switches, junction boxes, and power adapters where required. Route electrical cables through PVC/GI conduits, flexible conduits, cable trays, trunking, and approved pathways. Maintain proper phase, neutral, and earth connections. Provide proper grounding/earthing for CCTV equipment, racks, power supplies, and outdoor equipment where required. Check voltage supply before connecting sensitive CCTV and networking equipment. Identify and rectify loose connections, short circuits, power interruption, improper termination, and other electrical issues. Follow all applicable electrical safety procedures and client HSE requirements. CAT6 Network Cabling Install CAT6/CAT6A UTP network cable for IP cameras, NVRs, VMS servers, PoE switches, access control systems, and other network devices. Route CAT6 cables through cable trays, conduits, trunking, ceiling pathways, and wall conduits. Maintain proper separation between CAT6 data cables and electrical power cables. Maintain proper cable bending radius and avoid excessive pulling, crushing, kinking, or sharp bends. Label and identify cables from each camera location to the communication rack. Terminate RJ45 connectors, keystone jacks, patch panels, and network outlets. Follow T568A or T568B wiring standards consistently. Avoid unnecessary joints, splices, or damaged cable sections. Provide suitable service loops at camera and rack locations. CAT6 Testing & Certification Test completed CAT6 cables using professional network cable testers. Verify wire mapping, continuity, pair sequence, open circuit, short circuit, crossed pair, and other cable faults. Identify and rectify poor termination and cable connection problems. Support Fluke or equivalent cable certification testing where required. Maintain and submit cable testing reports where applicable. CCTV Camera Installation Install IP cameras, dome cameras, bullet cameras, PTZ cameras, thermal cameras, and other CCTV cameras. Install camera brackets, poles, junction boxes, outdoor housings, cable glands, conduits, and related accessories. Pull and terminate CAT6 and power cables for each camera. Perform camera alignment, focusing, field-of-view adjustment, and image positioning. Ensure outdoor camera connections are properly weatherproofed and protected. Verify camera mounting stability and professional cable management. CCTV Camera Troubleshooting Diagnose and resolve CCTV camera faults, communication problems, image problems, and power-related issues. Troubleshoot cameras that are offline, disconnected, showing video loss, receiving no PoE power, or experiencing intermittent connectivity. Troubleshoot blurred, distorted, noisy, flickering, black/blank, or poor-quality video. Troubleshoot IR/night-vision, date/time, recording, and configuration issues. Check camera power supply, PoE port, CAT6 cable, RJ45 termination, switch port, IP address, and network connectivity. Verify camera configuration including IP address, subnet mask, gateway, DNS, NTP, resolution, frame rate, bitrate, encoding, and recording settings. Troubleshoot duplicate IP and network communication issues. Check ONVIF or applicable camera protocol compatibility. Replace defective cameras, connectors, cables, PoE ports, power supplies, or other faulty components where required. Perform authorized camera reset, reconfiguration, firmware update, and NVR/VMS re-registration. Verify live view, recording, playback, remote viewing, and analytics after troubleshooting. Maintain proper troubleshooting and service records. NVR / DVR / VMS Troubleshooting Troubleshoot camera connection and recording problems in NVR, DVR, and VMS platforms. Add, remove, modify, and reconfigure cameras. Check recording schedules, storage status, HDD health, user permissions, and playback functionality. Troubleshoot communication between cameras, PoE switches, NVRs, servers, and monitoring workstations. Support remote viewing and network access configuration. Rack, Patch Panel & Switch Cabling Install and organize CAT6 cables inside network and CCTV racks. Terminate cables into patch panels and connect them to PoE/network switches using patch cords. Maintain accurate rack, patch-panel, and switch-port labeling. Perform professional cable dressing using Velcro straps, cable managers, and other accessories. Maintain proper separation between power and data cabling. Testing, Commissioning & Maintenance Test every CCTV camera and associated equipment after installation. Verify live view, recording, playback, camera coverage, night vision, remote access, and analytics functions. Perform preventive and corrective maintenance of CCTV cameras, NVR/DVR, VMS, PoE switches, racks, and cabling. Check connectors, cable conditions, power supplies, storage status, and network connectivity. Conduct final system testing before handover. Safety Responsibilities Follow company and client HSE requirements at all times. Attend mandatory HSE induction before working at client sites where applicable. Use appropriate PPE, including safety helmet, safety shoes, gloves, safety harness, and eye protection. Follow safe procedures for electrical work, ladder use, scaffolding, and work-at-height activities. Maintain a clean and safe working environment. Documentation & Reporting Maintain camera installation records and cable identification schedules. Record camera IP addresses, locations, rack numbers, patch-panel ports, and switch ports. Prepare cable testing, installation, maintenance, and troubleshooting reports. Report material shortages, defective equipment, site obstacles, and technical issues to the supervisor/project engineer. Assist in preparing as-built drawings and final handover documentation. Job Standard The selected technician must be able to independently perform or effectively support  electrical wiring, CAT6 cabling, CCTV camera installation, camera troubleshooting, NVR/DVR/VMS configuration, testing, commissioning, preventive maintenance, and technical service work  while maintaining professional quality, safety, and customer satisfaction.

job_description: Job Overview The Transmission Manager/Assistant Manager is responsible for overseeing the Transmission network & optical fiber network infrastructure planning, deployment, maintenance, fault management, restoration, network expansion, and field team activities.  The position will ensure high network availability, fast fault resolution, efficient resource utilization, and quality customer service by seamless management of transmission engineers,  fiber technicians & third-party vendors.  The role requires strong technical knowledge of transmission technologies, fiber-optic infrastructure, splicing and ISP operations, along with effective team and vendor management skills. Key Responsibilities Manage and oversee daily operations, maintenance, and performance of the ISP transmission and fiber network infrastructure, ensuring high availability, stability, redundancy, and SLA compliance. Monitor transmission links, equipment, interfaces, alarms, optical levels, and network utilization while coordinating with NOC and relevant technical teams to ensure smooth service delivery. Lead fault and incident management activities, including identification, troubleshooting, escalation, and restoration of fiber and transmission-related issues such as fiber cuts, high-loss links, equipment failures, power issues, and customer-impacting outages. Conduct Root Cause Analysis (RCA) for major and recurring incidents, establish corrective and preventive actions, and ensure continuous improvement in network reliability and restoration performance. Support planning, execution, and monitoring of FTTH/FTTx network expansion projects, including fiber deployment, route planning, splicing, termination, testing, and technical acceptance activities. Supervise fiber installation, splicing, and testing activities using OTDR, optical power meter, VFL, and other fiber-testing tools while ensuring proper optical performance, labeling, documentation, and quality standards. Develop and implement preventive maintenance plans for fiber infrastructure, transmission equipment, and OSP assets to minimize service disruption and identify potential risks proactively. Lead and manage fiber operations teams, including engineers, supervisors, technicians, and field personnel by allocating tasks, monitoring performance, providing technical guidance, and ensuring operational readiness. Manage third-party service providers, contractors, and vendors by monitoring service quality, productivity, compliance, technical support, and ensuring completed work meets approved design, quality, and safety standards. Maintain accurate documentation of fiber routes, splice diagrams, core allocation, network topology, GIS records, asset information, fault history, maintenance activities, and operational reports. Ensure proper inventory management of fiber cables, closures, TJBs, FDBs, splitters, ODF, patch panels, tools, and critical spare materials required for smooth operations. Ensure compliance with company standards, safety procedures, change management processes, and quality requirements during network deployment, maintenance, and restoration activities. Coordinate with Customer Support, NOC, Core Network, and other departments to resolve customer-impacting issues, prioritize critical outages, and support enterprise and high-priority customer restoration. Monitor operational KPIs including network availability, fault resolution time, MTTR, recurring incidents, preventive maintenance compliance, and service performance, providing improvement recommendations to management. Perform any other technical, operational, or management-related tasks assigned by the supervisor or management.

 ১. পদের সারসংক্ষেপ 
 কমি শেফ কিচেন টিমের একটি প্রাথমিক কিন্তু গুরুত্বপূর্ণ পদ, যেখানে কর্মরত ব্যক্তি শেফ দ্য পার্টি, সু শেফ এবং হেড শেফের তত্ত্বাবধানে খাদ্য প্রস্তুত, উপকরণ প্রস্তুতকরণ এবং কিচেনের দৈনন্দিন কার্যক্রম পরিচালনায় সহায়তা করবেন। 
 এই পদের মূল উদ্দেশ্য হলো প্রতিষ্ঠানের নির্ধারিত মান, রেসিপি এবং স্বাস্থ্যবিধি অনুসরণ করে খাদ্য প্রস্তুতির প্রাথমিক ধাপগুলো সম্পন্ন করা, কিচেনের কার্যক্রমকে সুশৃঙ্খল রাখা এবং সিনিয়র শেফদের কাজে সহায়তা করা। 
 
 ২. প্রধান দায়িত্ব ও কর্তব্য 
 ক) খাদ্য প্রস্তুতি সহায়তা 
 
 শেফদের নির্দেশনা অনুযায়ী বিভিন্ন খাদ্য উপকরণ প্রস্তুত করা (কাটা, ধোয়া, পরিমাপ করা ইত্যাদি)। 
 নির্ধারিত রেসিপি অনুযায়ী খাদ্য প্রস্তুতির প্রাথমিক ধাপে সহায়তা করা। 
 খাবারের গুণগত মান বজায় রাখতে সতর্কতা অবলম্বন করা। 
 খাবারের সঠিক উপস্থাপন নিশ্চিত করতে সহায়তা করা। 
 
 খ) কিচেন পরিচালনা ও পরিচ্ছন্নতা 
 
 কিচেনের নির্ধারিত কর্মস্থল পরিষ্কার, স্বাস্থ্যসম্মত ও সুশৃঙ্খল রাখা। 
 রান্নাঘরের যন্ত্রপাতি, সরঞ্জাম ও উপকরণ ব্যবহারের পর পরিষ্কার রাখা। 
 স্বাস্থ্যবিধি ও খাদ্য নিরাপত্তা নীতিমালা মেনে চলা। 
 
 গ) উপকরণ ব্যবস্থাপনা 
 
 খাদ্য উপকরণ সঠিকভাবে সংরক্ষণ ও ব্যবহার নিশ্চিত করা। 
 উপকরণের সতেজতা ও গুণগত মান পরীক্ষা করা। 
 প্রয়োজনীয় উপকরণের ঘাটতি হলে সংশ্লিষ্ট কর্তৃপক্ষকে অবহিত করা। 
 
 ঘ) টিমওয়ার্ক ও সহযোগিতা 
 
 কিচেন টিমের অন্যান্য সদস্যদের সাথে সমন্বয় রেখে কাজ করা। 
 সিনিয়র শেফদের নির্দেশনা অনুসরণ করা এবং তাদের কাজে সহায়তা করা। 
 ব্যস্ত সময়ে দ্রুত ও দক্ষতার সাথে কাজ সম্পন্ন করা। 
 
 
 ৩. প্রয়োজনীয় যোগ্যতা ও দক্ষতা 
 
 কুলিনারি আর্টস বা ফুড প্রোডাকশন বিষয়ে প্রশিক্ষণ থাকলে অগ্রাধিকার দেওয়া হবে। 
 রেস্টুরেন্ট, ক্যাফে বা হোটেল কিচেনে  কমপক্ষে ১–২ বছরের অভিজ্ঞতা  থাকলে অগ্রাধিকার। 
 খাদ্য প্রস্তুতি, রান্নার মৌলিক কৌশল এবং কিচেন ব্যবস্থাপনা সম্পর্কে প্রাথমিক ধারণা। 
 স্বাস্থ্যবিধি ও খাদ্য নিরাপত্তা নিয়ম সম্পর্কে সচেতনতা। 
 দলগতভাবে কাজ করার সক্ষমতা এবং দায়িত্বশীল মনোভাব। 
 দ্রুত শেখার আগ্রহ এবং পেশাদারিত্ব বজায় রাখার মানসিকতা। 
 
 
 ৪. কর্মপরিবেশ ও কর্মঘণ্টা 
 
 রান্নাঘরের পরিবেশে দীর্ঘ সময় দাঁড়িয়ে কাজ করার সক্ষমতা থাকতে হবে। 
 প্রয়োজনে শিফট ভিত্তিক কাজ, সপ্তাহান্তে বা বিশেষ দিনে কাজ করতে হতে পারে। 
 
 
 ৫. বেতন ও সুবিধা 
 
 প্রার্থীর যোগ্যতা ও অভিজ্ঞতার ভিত্তিতে প্রতিষ্ঠানের নীতিমালা অনুযায়ী বেতন নির্ধারণ করা হবে। 
 প্রতিষ্ঠানের নিয়ম অনুযায়ী অন্যান্য সুবিধা প্রদান করা হবে।
